company.title: My orders
company.description: Follow each order: confirmation by FlexiPay, transfer, validation and credits added.

company.stateAwaitingPayment: Order confirmed: make the transfer to the account below, then declare it.

company.rejectedTitle: Proof rejected: declare your transfer again

admin.description: Confirm company orders, then validate each transfer once the funds reach the FlexiPay account.

admin.rejectMessage: The order goes back to awaiting payment; the company sees the reason and can declare again.
admin.rejectReason: Reason for rejection (shown to the company)
admin.rejectReasonHint: For example: different amount received, transfer not found.
admin.rejectedToast: Proof rejected: the company is asked to declare again.
admin.fourEyesInfo: Above {threshold} of credits, two different administrators must validate the payment.
